title: TAP SBOM supplemental manifest
description: Declared out-of-band components of a published image (req-cicd-sbom-3): everything entering the image outside a package manager. One manifest per image, beside its Dockerfile; loader-validated against this schema; merged into the generated CycloneDX + SPDX during the single derivation. The manifest declares IDENTITY and RATIONALE; facts the build already states are DERIVED at generation time and must not be authored here — file hashes from the scanned artifact, and, for a copied-image component, version + source + purl from the Dockerfile COPY --from pin that lands it (tap#225).

_description.description: Human/AI-readable purpose of this manifest instance.

format.description: Manifest format discriminator; bump on breaking shape changes.

_description.description: Why this component exists and how it enters the image.

name.description: Component name as it appears in the SBOM (and in the req-cicd-sbom-7 canary list).

version.description: Exact version. Authored only for a self-built or vendored component; FORBIDDEN for copied-image, where it is derived from the Dockerfile pin.

source.description: Provenance: pinned source URL. Authored only for a self-built or vendored component; FORBIDDEN for copied-image, where the upstream image ref incl. digest is derived from the Dockerfile pin.

source_kind.description: How the bytes were produced/acquired. 'copied-image' means a Dockerfile COPY --from=<repo>:<tag>@sha256:<digest> lands it, and that reference is the authoring site for its version and digest.

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the image; generation hashes THIS file per-arch, and for a copied-image component JOINS the entry to the COPY --from site that lands this path.

purl.description: package-url where one exists. Authored only for a self-built or vendored component; FORBIDDEN for copied-image, which declares the version-free 'purl_base' instead.

purl_base.description: package-url WITHOUT the '@<version>' suffix, e.g. 'pkg:github/astral-sh/uv'. Required for copied-image: generation appends the derived version, so the purl cannot name a version the image does not ship. The pattern bans '@', '?' and '#' so a version cannot be smuggled back in as a base that already carries one ('pkg:x/y@0.12.3' would render 'pkg:x/y@0.12.3@0.12.16') or hidden behind a qualifier or fragment.

then.description: Derive, do not declare: version/source/purl come from the Dockerfile COPY --from pin (tap#225). Authoring them created a second copy that drifted four uv releases out of date in a published, attested SBOM.
No build reference states these, so they are authored — and verified against their pin where one exists (the FIPS provider: tap/fips_pins.py).
